## Invitations

A total of 1888 people were invited during the reporting period. Of these, 1199 attended, giving an attendance rate of 63.5 per cent. The figures indicate that attendance represented more than half of those invited. The invitation activity and attendance figures are recorded together to support routine monitoring of outreach activity and participation. No further interpretation of individual attendance is included in this report.

## Contact

SMS contact was recorded for 1623 invitations. A reminder was also recorded for 1623 people. These contact activities formed part of the invitation and follow-up process. Staff continue to phone people who missed appointments, providing an additional means of contact where attendance did not take place. The SMS and reminder figures are presented separately from the attendance figures so that contact activity and attendance can be reviewed distinctly.

Prepared by G. Evans.
